'''Flensors''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Scavenger/Legends|carrion]] [[Bird/Legends|bird]] capable of flight and native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]]<ref name="CSWE" /> within the [[Saki system/Legends|Saki system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The planet's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]], considered flensors a bad omen, especially if they saw one flying over their [[bonepit]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flensors were first mentioned in the novel ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'' which was released in [[2004]] and written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]]. They then received an entry in the [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] along with numerous co-authors. Neither source states if they are sentient or not.
